args.summary: Payment not sent. The quote for CornerCoffee $25.00 showed a $3.50 fee (14% of the amount), which exceeds the $2.00 safety fee cap, so the wallet marks it as unable to complete. I did not submit the payment or try any workaround. Cash is unchanged at $120.00, with nothing arriving and no pending requests.
